title: CWRU Taiwanese Student Association
content_html:
The CWRU Taiwanese Student Association (CWRUTSA) is a student organization at Case Western Reserve University in Cleveland, Ohio. The organization serves students from Taiwan enrolled at Case Western Reserve University (CWRU), the Cleveland Institute of Music (CIM), and the Cleveland Institute of Art (CIA), creating a welcoming environment where members can share and experience Taiwanese culture through various events.

According to its official university community portal, CWRUTSA provides informational and counseling resources for international students and their families across academic, cultural, and legal areas. The organization also aims to build a professional network of Taiwanese students within CWRU and across the greater Cleveland community, and to inspire Taiwanese, Taiwanese American, and all other students to appreciate the cultural diversity CWRU has to offer.
